column1: The morning air feels cool.
A small bird waits by the gate.
Blue clouds drift above the hill.
Please place the book on this desk.
We walk along the quiet river.
Fresh bread rests near the window.
The old clock marks every hour.
Green leaves shine after the rain.
My friend draws a simple map.
A warm light fills the room.
The train arrives before noon.
Three boats cross the calm lake.
Write each word at an even pace.
The garden path turns to the east.
Soft snow covers the stone wall.
An orange kite climbs into the sky.
I hear music from the next room.
Keep both hands close to home row.
The silver moon appears at dusk.
Today we begin a short journey.
